title: Top Refrigerator Brand Scores (Consumer Reports, 2025)
desc: Consumer Reports’ 2025 overall brand scores for French-door refrigerators, combining its laboratory testing, member survey data and product-line breadth. This source table ranks brands within this refrigerator style; it is not a reliability-only score or a model-specific recommendation.

source.name: Consumer Reports — Best Refrigerator Brands of 2025 (licensed reprint)
source.note: The French-door refrigerator section and first five brands, their overall scores and order were checked against Consumer Reports’ licensed 2025 reprint by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-10-23. The source combines lab tests, member survey results and brand product-line breadth. It states no single brand is best across all refrigerator styles; scores are not model-level guarantees.
